call_points.text: FY27 order inflow target held at ₹8,000 Cr, with management saying it will try to cross it.
Order book ₹14,424 Cr at 30 June 2026; consultancy ₹10,498 Cr, turnkey ₹3,926 Cr.
Middle East new mega projects on hold; Aramco still in initial stages with no major inquiry.
Coal gasification: bidding for feasibility studies after the government's ₹34,000 Cr gap-funding policy.
No provision write-backs expected; guarantee and warranty provisions reverse only after the defect liability period.
RFCL now contributing regularly; a dividend from it is expected this financial year.
No plan to distribute the surplus cash; other investment plans under consideration.
Analyst pressed on consultancy execution rate; management called it cyclical and declined a specific figure.
Asked for the bid pipeline size, management said it was difficult to quantify.
Management expects minimum 10% to 15% increase in revenue for the current financial year.
Consultancy segment margin will be maintained in the range of 20% to 25%, and LSTK business segment profit around 5% to 7%.

timeline.summary: Engineers India entered into a tripartite agreement with KFin Technologies and Alankit Assignments on April 20, 2026.
Engineers India published its FY25-26 investor presentation outlining financial performance, order book growth, and strategic outlook.
Engineers India Limited hosted an Analyst/Institutional Investor Meet on 22 May 2026, with audio recording available at the provided link.
Engineers India hosted its Q4 FY26 earnings conference call on May 22, 2026, guiding for 10-15% revenue growth in FY27.
Engineers India reports BSE and NSE levied **₹5.37 lakh** each for non-compliance with Regulation 17(1) for Q1FY27
Board of Engineers India Limited noted fines of Rs5,36,900 each levied by NSE and BSE, requested waiver, meeting held 22 September 2026.
Engineers India released its Q2FY27 investor presentation highlighting order book growth and project execution.
Engineers India Limited participated in a meeting with several funds and individual investors on 30 October 2026, with audio recording available on the company website.
